texts.text: FLUED 是一个无分词器的字节级语言建模项目。与传统 BPE 分词不同，模型在编码阶段动态地把字节流编译成语义块：边界检测器读取隐藏状态的增量，为每个字节位置输出一个置信分数。2026 年的实验表明，经过 GRPO 优化的 R4 臂会把文本切成约 24 段，接近人工标注的粒度；而 S0 臂只切 12 段左右。这种「边界即语义」的思路，让压缩率与可解释性第一次同时变得可测量、可比较。

texts.text: FLUED is a tokenization-free, byte-level language modeling project. Instead of a fixed BPE vocabulary built before training, the model compiles the byte stream into semantic chunks during encoding: a boundary detector reads hidden-state deltas and emits a confidence score for every byte position. In the 2026 experiments, the GRPO-optimized R4 arm chose a granularity of roughly 24 segments per 500 bytes — close to human annotation — while the S0 arm preferred coarser chunks.
